description: Hand-calculated reference identities independent of any generated page tests.

bayes_updating.identity: Beta(2,2) prior plus 3 successes and 1 failure gives Beta(5,3), posterior mean 5/8.

least_squares_loss.identity: For points (0,1),(1,3) and line y_hat=1+2x, residuals are [0,0] and SSE is 0; with intercept shifted to 0, residuals are [1,1] and SSE is 2.

logistic_probability.identity: At z=0, odds are 1 and logistic probability is 1/2.

exponential_decay.identity: After one half-life t=ln(2)/lambda, the remaining amount is N0/2; with N0=80 and lambda=ln(2), N(1)=40.
